commit.message:
Maker Week: fix trailmark-finding-triage's broken query recipe (+ one-call evidence packet) (#360)

* fix(trailmark-finding-triage): make the subgraph recipes work on Trailmark 0.5

The taint, privilege-boundary, entrypoint-reachable and blast-radius recipes
built `set(engine.subgraph(...))`. Trailmark 0.5 returns node dicts from
subgraph(), so the recipe raised `TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict'` and the
model had to improvise the membership checks by hand. Compare node ids instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(trailmark-finding-triage): build the evidence packet in one call

Add scripts/evidence_packet.py, which builds the Trailmark graph and
preanalysis once and returns the Graph Evidence fields (bound node, all
matches, entrypoint paths with trust level, subgraph membership, callers,
callees, downstream) for one or more file/line findings. SKILL.md gets a
shortcut section for Steps 2-4; the manual steps stay for function-name and
SARIF inputs. The script gathers facts only; the verdict stays with the model.

Tests cover binding (exact, nested, ambiguous, containers), path handling,
argument and empty-graph errors, --out, and run every query-recipes.md block
against a real Trailmark 0.5 graph.

Bump trailmark to 0.12.0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
